QuestInfo.name: Blade Lord
QuestInfo.0: Ask Arec about becoming a Blade Lord.
QuestInfo.1: To become a Blade Lord, you must touch the Holy Stone at the Holy Ground in the Snowfield. You can get there from #rSharp Cliff I#k.\n\n#i4031059##t4031059# #b#c4031059# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You have become a Blade Lord!

0.0: All you have to do is go where I tell you, beat an enemy, and bring back the spoils... If you don't think you can handle that, go back to Victoria Island now. Ossyria is no place for weaklings.
0.1: There is an obelisk at Sharp Cliff I near El Nath. Behind it, there's a path to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield. Touch the Holy Stone there, and you'll be warped to another dimension. Your enemy is waiting for you there.
0.2: Bring me proof of your victory and we'll see if you're ready.\r\n#b(You will be moved to the Holy Ground at the Snowfield if you accept.)#k

no.0: Too scared? Just give it up, then!
